items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer states 'Walter made that arrangement for Cab's band' and 'Cab... studied saxophone with Walter'. The interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not claim a personal or professional relationship with Walter, only narrating Walter's connection to Cab Calloway.

ctx.x: Walter made that arrangement for Cab's band.
"Ratamacue" is recorded with your first session with that band.
